classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the product of three face areas as squared volume and model the three closed strap perimeters as a linked system for three dimensions.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A rectangular prism has faces of area 66, 48 and 88. Find the volume of the prism.

answer.worked:
Let the positive side lengths be $x,y,z$. The three face areas are $xy,yz,zx$, so their product is the square of the volume.
$$\begin{aligned}V^2&=(xy)(yz)(zx)=66(48)(88)=278784\\V&=\sqrt{278784}=528.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: A box in the shape of a rectangular prism is strapped as shown. The length of the straps are 100, 60 and 80.

spec.description: Explicit closed box front/depth/view. Three closed source straps reduced from filled bands to editable semantic centre paths: fixeddepth loop has visible right/top and hiddenleft/bottom; fixedx loop visiblefront/top and hiddenback/bottom; fixedheight loop visiblefront/right and hiddenback/left. All three loops and x/y/z dimensions retained. Strap lengths not individually assigned in given. Semantic loops are construction separate from solid edge visibility.

children.label: i
children.prompt: Find the dimensions of the box.

answer.worked:
Each closed strap has length twice the sum of one pair of dimensions. Assign the strap lengths to pairs in any order.
$$\begin{aligned}x+y&=50,\quad x+z=30,\quad y+z=40\\2(x+y+z)&=120\\x+y+z&=60\\x&=60-40=20,\\y&=60-30=30,\\z&=60-50=10.\end{aligned}$$
